critical_code_review_comments: Gate placement verified: lines 9668-9730 inside `if tu['name'] == 'finish':` branch at indent 12, BEFORE the `summary = ...` assignment at line 9731. ✓

`continue` at line 9727 (indent 28) is inside `if _blanks:` > `try:` > `if finish` > `for tu in tool_uses:`. Python's `continue` targets the nearest enclosing loop — `try` does NOT capture `continue` — so it correctly skips to the next iteration of the outer tool_uses loop (NOT the outer agent iteration loop). After all tool_uses processed, `finished` remains False, the injected tool_result reaches the AI, and force_tool_use_next_iter=True is set. ✓

Threshold is AND not OR (line 9688: `_sec_count <= 1 and len(_text_only) < 800`). Verified by simulation tests `test_one_section_but_lots_of_text_is_NOT_blank` and `test_many_sections_but_no_text_is_NOT_blank` — neither triggers a false block. Risk of infinite loop on a real homepage = NONE. ✓

Empty ctx.pages handled via `(ctx.pages or {}).items()` — simulation test `test_empty_pages_dict_returns_no_blanks` confirms None and {} both pass safely. Single-page projects on ctx.current_html will NOT be blocked. ✓
Thresholds (≤1 section, <800 chars) match BLANK PAGE DETECTOR at line 10047 exactly — no UX inconsistency between warn-time and block-time.
Both message formats injected: Anthropic uses `content=[{type:'tool_result', tool_use_id, content}]`, OpenAI uses `{role:'tool', tool_call_id, content}`. ✓

Section regex `<section\b[^>]*\bid\s*=\s*["\'][^"\']+["\']` correctly requires an `id` attribute, so SCAFFOLD_PLACEHOLDER skeletons and bare <section> tags do NOT inflate the count (verified in `test_section_without_id_does_not_count`).
Exception in gate is caught at line 9728 (logs warning) — gate failure FAILS OPEN (finish proceeds). This is the safe default; if the gate itself crashes the user is not stuck.

rca of the issue: Original failure: AI called create_page (skeleton with only <h1> + SCAFFOLD_PLACEHOLDER) then finish() before apply_section was ever called for sidebar pages. BLANK PAGE DETECTOR warned per-tool but had no enforcement. Fix: PRE-FINISH GATE in _stream_one_provider's finish branch scans ctx.pages, identifies any page with ≤1 sectioned element AND <800 chars meaningful text, injects a tool_result demanding apply_section for each blank page, sets force_tool_use_next_iter=True, and `continue`s to skip the rest of the finish branch (no summary assignment, finished stays False). The gate is in the right indent level, the conditions are AND (no false positives on real homepages), empty ctx.pages is handled safely (no false positives on single-page projects).
